CLMA 883/2013 
 In 
AO No. 59/2013
Hon’ble B.S. Verma, J. 
 Heard Sri M.K. Goyal, Advocate appearing on 
behalf of the appellant. 
 Admit. 
 Issue notices to the respondents. 
 Summon the LCR. 
 List after the service is effected upon the 
respondents and LCR is received. 
 Also heard on stay application. 
 If the appellant deposits the entire awarded 
amount, minus the statutory deposit, before the 
tribunal concerned within a period of six weeks, 
the execution of impugned award shall remain 
stayed. 
 The stay application stands disposed of. 
 
 (B.S.Verma, J.)
